_about: Whitelist of image_urls that legitimately appear in multiple missions / surfaces. The cross-mission and cross-mission-basename dedup filters in scripts/slice-a-salvage.mjs consult this registry and allow shared appearances. Populated from Marko's `cross-mission-share-ok` exception tags in the /dev/slice-a-review labeling. Add new entries as: { image_url: <url>, missions: [<id>, ...], rationale: <one-liner> }

shared.rationale: Apollo 9 Saturn V launch frame — equally a hero for the mission AND for the launcher + launch-complex galleries. Marko `cross-mission-share-ok` tag, round-1 2026-06-18: 'good image for launcher and launch site as well'.
Soyuz-TMA against ISS / Earth backdrop — Marko labeled this 'old image is amazing, good for launcher and launch site' (round-1 2026-06-18, share-ok tag).
